subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a narrow core status-label display fix now, wait for the open cross-repository candidate PR to be rebased and proven, or defer this to broader status attribution work?
rationale: The source-level gap is valid, but the issue has product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals and an open conflicting cross-repository candidate, so automation should not pick the landing path without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a narrow core display fix
options.body: Land a focused shared-status change with terminal-safe friendly labels, raw-key fallback/detail, and regression coverage while leaving broader JSON attribution separate.

options.title: Wait for the candidate PR
options.body: Ask the open cross-repository PR author to rebase against current main, address terminal-safety and status-builder drift, and provide real behavior proof before this issue closes.

options.title: Defer to broader attribution
options.body: Keep this issue as product input for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85688 and accept that CLI/TUI status remains UUID-heavy until that larger design lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow core display fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused shared-status change with terminal-safe friendly labels, raw-key fallback/detail, and regression coverage while leaving broader JSON attribution separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses TUI, shared status, and session-display product boundaries where recent path history points most strongly to steipete.
